reviews.title: This app is a scam
reviews.text: I signed up for the free trial to save one of the photos I’ve edited, it connected with my bank account, grand (it automatically renews if you don’t cancel it within a week. This I knew), but when I went to cancel it literally within less than 10mins, tell me why there is absolutely zero proof of this free trial, so therefore no way of cancelling it. Because I’d spent an hour editing this photo, I just wanted to save it, so I said I’d pay for 1 month, no proof of this either. God only knows what my next bill is going to be. Not being able to cancel a subscription is the first sign of a scam. I don’t want anything to do with this app. I want my subscriptions (all of them) to be cancelled.

reviews.title: Retouch Not Working on Pro Plan
reviews.text:
paid for the Pro plan expecting full access to the app’s features, but I’m extremely disappointed. The app blocks the Retouch feature with the message “You’ve reached today’s Pro limit,” even though my subscription is active and fully paid.

What’s even more frustrating is that another Pro account in my family works normally, so there is clearly inconsistency between users. At no point is it clearly explained that there are such restrictive daily limits for basic facial editing tools.

The Pro subscription is expensive, but in practice the experience feels limited like a free version. More transparency with paying subscribers is the minimum expected.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money.
reviews.text:
My former review is below… from when i rated this app 5 stars. Ironically right after that, the quality has dropped so much that i just cancelled my account that I’ve had for years. 1. I just ran into a limit on face swapping in less than one day even though I’m paying. 2. The face swap tool used to let you try multiple times, and the retry button is still there but it doesn’t do anything. 3. It assumes you want to look 18 when you’re 40. I didn’t ask to be aged down. I didn’t ask for ageism. I simply wanted to swap the face with a better photo, but it edits beyond that and you can’t stop it. 4. It doesn’t recognize that there’s a face there half the time when it should. 5. You can’t change hair color for one person in a photo without changing the hair color for everyone. 6. It will weirdly and randomly make your face look dirty. 7. The eraser tool stopped working and when I emailed about it, I told them that I had already re-downloaded the app. They completely ignored what I said and told me to try re downloading the app. Not only is it becoming useless, but they’re rude. I’ve found better programs. My previous review from when it worked, because I do give credit when it’s due. It’s just not anymore:

I’ve been using Airbrush for years. It’s still the only photo editing app that doesn’t let me down. I’m making professional quality work… Images animated into videos, and I am using expensive AI apps. I inevitably have to download what the image generators give me onto my phone
